claims.text: The patient is a 53-year-old female.

no

claims.text: The pain comes on when she walks.

right now it's not there

nothing right now

nothing right now

claims.explanation: Smoking status was never discussed in the visit.

evidence.quote: she has a past medical history of diabetes and high blood pressure
i know we have you on metformin
